limits: Development cases, including cases used to refine the prompt. Not an independent quality benchmark or field-accuracy result.
One request per case through the real Cloudflare REST API using the shipping endpoint handler; excludes browser startup and rendering.
The final run includes phrase diagnostics; the initial six-case baseline did not. It compares the combined prompt and request changes, not an isolated prompt ablation.
Local replay uses the skill rescue and reranking functions with general genre. It is not a browser interaction test.

Success means the model returned text. Residual repetition and promotional wording remain in some cases. The LinkedIn model output also binds the 18-month period to building the product, a contextual inference the local fact inventory cannot detect.

results.input:
We are incredibly excited to share some news about our journey over the past 18 months.

When we started building Kairoset, we knew that onboarding was broken. What we did not realize was just how deeply it impacted everything downstream.

Onboarding is not a checklist. It is a promise.

Our team spent months talking to 40 customers, and the insights were game-changing. Teams were spending an average of 11 hours per new hire on manual setup, copying data between systems that do not talk to each other.

So we built something different: a platform that leverages intelligent automation to streamline the entire process end to end.

The results speak for themselves. Setup time is down 73 percent, we have onboarded 200 teams, and our satisfaction score sits at 4.8.

But here is the thing nobody talks about. The real win was not the time saved. It was watching a new engineer ship code on day two instead of day nine.

That is the kind of impact that keeps us going, and we are thrilled about what comes next.

We are thrilled to unveil Kairoset 4.0, a transformative release that redefines what is possible in onboarding automation.

This release represents a significant milestone in our journey to empower teams everywhere. We have listened carefully to your feedback and are excited to deliver a suite of powerful new capabilities.

Our cutting-edge mapping engine now automatically detects and maps fields across your connected systems, eliminating hours of tedious manual configuration.

We have completely reimagined our search infrastructure, delivering results up to 40 times faster than before.

Bulk export now handles up to 50000 records in a single operation, with robust error handling built in from the ground up.

Audit logs give full visibility into every change, with 90 days of retention on all plans.

We believe these improvements will fundamentally transform how your team works, and the release is available today.
